lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p31 - Listen, point & say

details: Listen, Point and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

details: Trace gives students practice in writing the letters and aids spelling. Write gives students controlled practice spelling. It reinforces whole-word memory, letter order, and neat handwriting. Match shows recognition of word and image.
Look for neat and accurate tracing, consistent letter formation, and neat handwriting within the lines and accurate matching.
